confidence_notes: Food and drink figures come from scattered travel-guide prices: beer at about INR 180-220 in guesthouses and restaurants, and TripBase approximations of about $1.50 for a budget meal, $5 for a mid-range meal, $1 for coffee, $2 for beer and $4 for a cocktail. I did not find an aggregated cost-of-living index for Hampi. A cappuccino at a traveller cafe will cost more than local filter coffee (INR 10-20), so I estimated it at about INR 120. Hampi is in a heritage zone with limited bar licensing, so alcohol is sold informally and inconsistently. I have no direct data for wine, so I estimated it from the local price relationship to beer and Karnataka pricing. The cocktail estimate is also based on beer prices plus the one TripBase figure. Accommodation figures are model estimates, not checked against listings. I based them on Hampi's budget-backpacker character, with dorms and guesthouses around Hampi Bazaar and Virupapur Gaddi. Three-star hotels are mostly in Kamalapur and Hospet. Prices are seasonal: July is monsoon low season, so rates may be lower than these mid-level estimates.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared with Indian backpacker and heritage destinations such as Gokarna, Pushkar and rural Goa, adjusted for Hampi's smaller size, limited alcohol and lower hotel inventory.
